tasks.short: Observe cleaning equipment and maintain operating conditions

steps.what: Observe machine operations, gauges and thermometers and adjust controls to maintain specified conditions

tasks.design: Retain direct equipment observation and adjustment with the operator. A reporting screen does not remove physical tending or the need to interpret conditions.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task combines observation of the machine with immediate operational response.
tasks.enabler_now: No supplied evidence establishes replacement of this operating judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguish a normal variation from a condition requiring intervention.
tasks.human_edge: Connect instrument readings with actual machine behaviour.

reach.learn: Separate a measured reading from its operational meaning

evidence.claim: Generic production software does not establish replacement of cleaning equipment observation and control; no task saving is claimed.

assumptions: The operator observes and interprets conditions in s1; no structured safe condition or adjustment code is assumed.
Existing automatic controls stay in the baseline and receive no new saving.
Production log recording belongs to task 14375. No added deployment or upkeep is proposed here.
unknowns: Equipment control arrangements and operating limits
research_questions: Which observed variations most often require operator intervention?

incremental.description: No changed system or operating process

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100: all equipment observation and adjustment remains, giving zero gross and net savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read gauges and capture materials used, processing times and available test results with identifiers
Assemble production logs from captured fields without recopying them into repeated sections
Reconcile production logs with source observations and approve the completed record

tasks.design: Configure a single entry production log in the manufacturing record system category represented by {OPS_SYSTEM}. Captured values populate repeated log sections; the operator checks the record before approval.
tasks.previous_blocker: Readings and material notes may be recopied into recurring log sections or shift summaries.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forms can store a captured value once and reuse it in a fixed log layout.
tasks.still_hard: Ensure the reading and test result belong to the correct run and time.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a log entry that does not match what occurred at the equipment.
tasks.altitude: Own record completeness and source reconciliation.

reach.learn: Check run identity and source timing

evidence.claim: Native forms can reuse supplied process fields in fixed logs; the cleaning equipment scenario and savings are E1 model knowledge.

assumptions: In s1 the operator produces and checks equipment and run identifiers, timestamp, gauge value and units, material identity and quantity, processing start and finish times and test result source reference. Reading, manual capture and missing field resolution are included in 40 hours.

The gauge produces the physical reading; the operator supplies run context. Existing test personnel produce test results through the unchanged testing task before they can be included; no testing saving is claimed.
No structured discrepancy, acceptance or test pass flag is inferred. Missing source or uncertain run linkage returns to manual capture and checking in s1 or s3.
Native forms are used first. Savings require actual repeat copying today; a current single entry log has zero saving.
Equipment observation for control belongs only to task 14372; this task counts the additional work of recording data.
unknowns: Extent of repeat copying and existing native forms
research_questions: Does single entry logging reduce total effort after physical reading, capture and reconciliation?

already_counted.description: Reading and field capture plus final source reconciliation

incremental.description: Form upkeep and sampled log checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact log version, run, readings, material quantities, timing and test references; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 task scenarios: B=100, R=65 gives 35 gross and 28 net after 7 focal upkeep hours. Range 0-6 reflects retained physical capture, potential absence of repeat copying and existing native logs.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Improve production record quality while retaining physical cleaning process control.
reach: Help supervisors trace process logs to the correct run and source
role.ambitious_version: An operator with less repeated log copying and preserved attention to actual machine conditions.

job.title: Cleaning, Washing, and Metal Pickling Equipment Operators and Tenders
